QuestInfo.name: Taking Out the Alligators 1
QuestInfo.0: I hear something happened to the tribespeople of #m10004000#. I should go ask #p506# about this.
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with #p506# in #m10004000#. A few days ago, a group of tribespeople went hunting in the swamp and wound up being ambushed by a group of Ligators. She's worried about the sudden surge of Ligators, and other alligator monsters, taking over the swamp and asked me to reduce their numbers before they spawn out of control. I'll have to kill #r100 #o29#s#k and #r40 #o18#s#k and pick up #b20 #t4000018#s#k along the way.
QuestInfo.2: The tribespeople of #m10004000# got ambushed by the alligator herd at the swamp, so #p506# asked if I could help take care of the alligators. I responded by taking out 100 #o29#s and 40 #o18#s. Hopefully this will bring some peace back to the swamp.

0.0: It's been a while since I last saw you. How have you been? Unfortunate events have happened recently here in #m10004000#. A few days ago, a group of tribespeople went hunting in the swamp near #m10003000# to acquire some alligator skins, only to be ambushed by them. They came back alive, but they were seriously injured.
0.1: People haven't gone to the swamp for quite a while. During that time, the number of alligators increased dramatically, to the point where they are starting to attack people. Even #p511# has taken notice, and he has been just as concerned about it as we are. Can you help us, please?

yes.0: Thank you. Because of these recent events, #p511# decided we should hire an outsider to take care of the alligators. Since he is a very busy man, however, I have assumed the task of picking out that someone to help us, and I choose you. So please head over to the swamp and take out #r100 #o29#s#k and #r40 #o18#s#k and bring back #b20 #t4000018#s#k as evidence.
yes.1: The swamp can be reached through the sewage pipe in #m10003000#. I believe in you. Good luck.

no.0: You looked powerful enough to handle the task, at least in my eyes. Please reconsider your choice, because... if the alligators keep spawning in the swamp like this, it'll be really dangerous for everyone here, later down the road...

1.0: You're back earlier than expected! That's incredible! I knew I had asked the right person for the job. Thanks to you, there should be considerably fewer Ligators in the swamp now. Thank goodness...
1.1: Did you bring the #b#t4000018#s#k with you? I also have something for you as a sign of my appreciation for your hard work. Which of these do you need?

yes.0: #b#t4000018#s#k can also be used as medicine. I wanted you to bring them so that I could use them on people who have been attacked by the alligators. This scroll is our way of saying thanks, so please take it and put it to good use.

item.0: Please don't forget to bring back #b20 #t4000018#s#k.
